research.title: Image Preprocessing for Surface Defect Classification
bullets: Implemented assigned image resizing and contrast normalization routines for a surface defect dataset, following the research group's preprocessing specifications.
Checked processed images for clipping and inconsistent dimensions, and documented preprocessing failures for review before downstream classifier evaluation.

work.title: Inventory and Order Processing Support
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing lists, recorded missing or damaged items, and routed discrepancies to the appropriate staff.
Maintained stock records, organized order paperwork, and coordinated routine pickup arrangements using established procedures and daily task schedules.

projects.title: Gradient Feature Baseline for Traffic Sign Recognition
bullets: Implemented a traffic sign classification baseline using histogram of oriented gradients features and a linear support vector machine.
Evaluated predictions on a held-out image split and inspected confusion patterns among signs with similar outlines and contrasting interior markings.
